title: Figures 10-11: CDC Thin-Film Synthesis Schematic and Volumetric Capacitance Plots
description: Figure 10, 'CDC Synthesis and Electrochemical Test Cell Preparation Schematic', shows a sintered TiC plate undergoing '1. Chlorination @ 500°C' to form a TiC-CDC film and '2. Cell assembly' into a layered stack (TiC plate, CDC film, Teflon plates, electrolyte + separator), with an inset SEM micrograph (5 μm scale). Figure 11, 'Volumetric Capacitance of the Films in (A) TEABF4 and (B) H2SO4', plots volumetric capacitance (F/cm³) versus coating thickness (μm), both decreasing with increasing thickness.
